title: Risk Forecasting Comparisons in Decentralized Finance: An Approach in Constant Product Market Makers
authors: Lucas Mussoi, Fernanda Maria Müller, Marcelo S. Perlin
abstract: This paper investigates risk measurement within the Decentralized Finance (DeFi) ecosystem, focusing on liquidity pools that utilize Constant Product Market Makers (CPMMs). The study evaluates and compares the performance of various market risk forecasting models, specifically Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES), applied to decentralized liquidity pool data.
